decisions.reason: As a featured new product line closely tied to Dampsoft's core dental practice software, the digital anamnesis app fits the firm's aspirations around digitalising practices, and its slack as an established mid-sized vendor lets it carry the product while adoption grows.

The continuing education institute strengthens customer ties in the dental market at modest cost, and with no sign of a performance shortfall there is no trigger for problemistic search or divestment.
The remote support tool is a low-cost complement to the firm's support services that improves service efficiency, so it is likely retained even with only minor visibility on the website.
